description: Live Jupiter quote for a Solana swap: out amount, min out, route, and a price-impact estimate (hidden for tokens under 24 h old). Returns a plover.markets link where the human reviews and signs in their own wallet. Read-only; never asks for a key.

amount.description: Amount of `from` in UI units (e.g. 0.5 for 0.5 SOL)

from.description: Input token: mint address, or SOL / USDC

to.description: Output token: mint address, or SOL / USDC

name: get_quote
title: Solana swap quote + sign link
